text:
claire_cs: Heads-up: we're opening the Sparkline preview cohort next Tuesday. Need to confirm final seat assignments, consent docs, and the feedback funnel (micro-survey -> optional interview). Can we align here?

omar_pm: Thanks Claire. How many seats are we releasing this wave? I thought this was a 10-seat pilot.

claire_cs: Right, 10 seats total. 6 confirmed, 2 tentative, 2 reserved for partners.

jin_se: I can own the two tentatives if you share contact points. Also want to know if any of them need data-ingestion connectors or just API-only.

claire_cs: Tentatives are HorizonMed (needs connectors) and KestrelAI (API-only). HorizonMed legal asked about a data retention clause in the preview consent.

nikita_research: For consent, we usually have a short addendum: 30-day telemetry retention + anonymized excerpts for research. I'll draft a one-paragraph opt-in that we can attach.

omar_pm: Please keep legal language minimal. Claire, can you loop in legal if HorizonMed pushes back?

claire_cs: Will do. Taylor, can Support pre-seed any connector templates for HorizonMed?

taylor_support: Yup. I'll create a connector quickstart repo link and a troubleshooting checklist. Also plan to schedule a 30-min pre-onboard call for any partner that wants integration help.

jin_se: For enablement, propose two artifacts: 1) 20-min recorded quickstart walkthrough, 2) interactive office hours (60 min) in week 1. I can record the walkthrough and put it in the cohort folder.

omar_pm: Sounds good. Also, for feedback funnel: micro-survey at 48h (3 questions), follow-up 2-week NPS-style pulse, and invite-only deep-dive interviews for accounts with >10% usage or flagged issues.

claire_cs: Agree. Let's keep the survey tiny: onboarding ease (1-5), immediate blockers (free text), interest in interview (yes/no). Put a link to anonymized telemetry in the follow-up so they can see their usage snapshot.

nikita_research: I'll build a short telemetry snapshot template showing tokens/day, avg latency, failed requests. We should hide PII.

jin_se: Can we wire the 48h micro-survey to trigger a Slack DM to the assigned CS rep if someone reports "blocker" in free text? That way we can respond quickly.

ops_bot: Automation suggestion: trigger_alert("preview_blocker", customer_id) when survey_response contains "blocker" or "fail".

claire_cs: Love that. Ops, can you add that rule?

ops_bot: Rule scheduled: will evaluate after micro-survey deploy.

taylor_support: Quick ask: do we want to tag preview accounts with a billing hold flag so they don't accidentally get charged if they exceed trial units?

omar_pm: Yes, add `billing_hold: true` metadata for cohort accounts. Finance knows the list.

claire_cs: Renewal-risk capture: add a "renewal_risk" free-form column in the cohort tracker. Flag reasons like "integration delay", "privacy/legal concerns", "low usage". Who owns triage?

jin_se: I'll own triage of integration blockers for the first 2 weeks, escalate to Omar if it's infra-related.

nikita_research: Also want to capture qualitative themes in a single doc labeled "sparkline-preview-feedback" so we can run simple theme extraction at week 3. I'll keep notes from interviews there.

omar_pm: Good. Please also surface any ask for model tuning or extra prompts — we want to prioritize ops vs model work.

claire_cs: Scheduling: customers prefer late afternoons. Propose Tuesday 5pm PT for the office hours and Thursday 11am PT for a backup. I'll send calendar invites with two options. Use this invite blurb: ```Hi <name>, invite to Sparkline preview onboarding & office hours. Choose Tue 5pm PT or Thu 11am PT. We'll cover quickstart, connectors, and ops tips.```

taylor_support: I'll include the connector quickstart link in the invite. Also will pin a short FAQ in the cohort channel: common first-login issues, key error codes, how to reach Support.

jin_se: One more: capture sample prompts and blacklisted content patterns from customers for safety triage. If anything looks risky, we need to loop in Safety team ASAP.

claire_cs: Noted. Add a "safety_flag" checkbox in tracker.

ops_bot: Reminders scheduled: send invites at 1776550000, run micro-survey at 1776636400, compile week-1 usage rollup at 1776640000.

omar_pm: Action items recap: Claire (send invites + legal loop for HorizonMed), Jin (record walkthrough + manage integration triage), Taylor (connector templates & support FAQ), Nikita (consent blurb + telemetry snapshot + feedback doc), Ops_bot (automation & reminders). I'll consolidate in the cohort tracker.
